notes.title: Metalstorm 20250922 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Latest update going live [b]Tuesday, September 23rd at 8:00 AM PT[/b].  No client download required for this update. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2][p][b]New Ace Challenge: [/b]In case you missed the update from last week, we made a bunch of changes based on your feedback from the first Ace Challenge. Below is a list of those changes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved descriptions for scoring post-match results as well as additional information in the loading screen and help screen[/p][/*][*][p]Tuning adjustments to bot behaviors and difficulty, including bot skill in flaring.[/p][/*][*][p]Trophy Case will be viewable on other player profiles to view acquired Mementos.[/p][/*][*][p]Ace Challenge Memento’s will be featured in a variety of tiers:[/p][list][*][p]Common for 3-star Easy completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Uncommon for 3-star Medium completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare for 3-star Hard completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Epic for placing in the Top 100 on the Ace Challenge leaderboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary for placing 3rd, 2nd, or 1st on the Ace Challenge leaderboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Note: You will receive the Memento for your highest tier/accolade reached.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ace Challenge Memento’s will also show aircraft as well as teammate information.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some adjustments to certain star thresholds.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboard entries will now include Aircraft used and Level.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon defeat, the Ace will now eject.. [i]who knows when they may return![/i] 🫣[/p][/*][*][p]Some Art and UI tweaks to various screens and menus related to Ace Challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that had Ace Challenges contributing to player win rates in PvP.[/p][/*][/list][p]Alongside these changes, our newest Ace Challenge is going live TODAY, and you’ll be tasked against: [b]RICOCHET[/b] 🎯[/p][p][/p][p][b](New Map) Countdown:[/b] We know you’ve been [i]counting[/i] down the days for this, and we’re happy to announce that both [b]Countdown[/b] \[Day + Night] will be entering the rotation [b]September 23rd[/b] alongside this deployment. This brand new map had more points of interest and ways to find cover unlike any sandbox we’ve created for Metalstorm. There’s fun to be had for all roles and playstyles, so have fun exploring and make sure you [b]#showusyourmetal[/b] 💪[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080690/fe8e81bd9b8827fb070d93a4730a63d1847b2102.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Countdown Flight Pass:[/b] This coincidentally themed flight pass comes flying into Metalstorm on [b]Saturday, September 27th at 9:00 AM PT[/b]. As a reminder, purchasing the Flight Pass bundle through our [url="https://playmetalstorm.com/shop"]web shop[/url] earns you Star Points to redeem for rewards, as well as extra silver for your squadmates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080690/12cf1deaeacea37c0b8b30084f687379505ef292.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h2][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where players were receiving the wrong Memento tier based on their first Ace Challenge performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Issues & Feedback[/b] Please report any issues or bugs you might be experiencing in our Discord or contact us at [b]support@starform.co[/b]. Your feedback is welcome and appreciated as it helps us make Metalstorm the best it can be.

[i]The final countdown![/i][/p]

notes.title: Mission Briefing | Ace Challenges (PvE)
notes.content: [h3][b]Attention pilots![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]There are new threats arriving in Metalstorm, and you’re going to have to bring your best efforts if you want to survive and maximize your rewards. Allow us to introduce [b]Ace Challenges[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Ace Challenges are a [b]new beta feature[/b] set to go live on September 1st, 2025 at 12:00 PM PT. This is a brand new [b]3 player co-op[/b] PvE (player versus environment) mode which will have you go after unique and powerful Aces. These Aces will not be so easy to get to as you will first have to get through waves of enemies including Basic enemy aircraft, more deadly Elite variants, and maybe some things you haven’t seen before. We’ve adjusted our matchmaker a bit to help make sure you’ve got the backup you need as well. Trophies will not be considered, you’ll be paired with people up to 6 levels away from your equipped aircraft, and a reduced matchmaking time to get you back in the action quickly.[/p][p][/p][p]As you attempt an Ace Challenge run, your score will increase based on eliminations, medals, time, and damage taken. Efficiency and coordination are key if you want to earn the maximum rank of 3 stars. There are [b]3 difficulties[/b] to choose from with increasing rewards but be wary of biting off more than you can chew. Speaking of rewards, Ace Challenges provide a unique way of building up and claiming a variety of parts, silver, and cosmetics! Each day you’ll have 3 Reward Tickets which will reset at 12:00 PM PT. Ticketed runs will grant you free parts based on your performance, Silver which gets added to a bounty, and you’ll also still earn Pilot Level XP, Mastery XP, Flight Pass and Squad Event progress. If you’re out of tickets you can still compete for leaderboard positions, but keep in mind that the [b]Leaderboard[/b] is only for runs completed on the Hard difficulty level.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s not all there is to fight for either! Each Ace Challenge comes with an Ace Bounty with unlocked Silver rewards, a unique Pilot Icon, and a Memento that will be added to your Trophy Case for 3 Star completionists (any difficulty). The Silver from this works retroactively as well so you’ll see your bounty increase over the course of the event based on ticket-runs.[/p][p][/p][h3]Your first Ace target: [b]RUNWAY 🎯[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080690/138dcd3be29ccf69e84c7ed82db96533e3bb9760.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This first Ace Challenge will be available for one week. As mentioned previously, this is very much a “beta” event. We know there are many pilots wanting a PvE experience in Metalstorm, and we want to make sure we get Ace Challenges right. There will be a survey message in-game after the event, and we encourage all to provide feedback to help make Ace Challenges the best PvE experience possible.[/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to seeing your best runs, and we encourage you to share clips or content you make from Ace Challenges with us. [/p][p][/p][p][i]Happy hunting![/i][/p]

notes.title: Metalstorm 20250624 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Latest update going live June 24, 2025. There will be a new client to download with times varying by storefront. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Game Engine Update[/b][/h2][p] Over a year in the making, we are pleased to finally get the much-anticipated game engine upgrade out to all our pilots. Some of you may notice visual or performance enhancements, but the things you don’t see are the real prize here. Upgrading as big as we have will provide our team with stability, access to better and more tools, the ability to jump on issues more efficiently, and more capabilities to develop new kinds of content.. like night maps ;)[/p][p][/p][p]We want to extend a sincere gratitude to those of you who have helped in any of the playtesting opportunities to help us get this across the finish line, and we thank everyone for giving us your patience and time while we focused efforts on quality improvements. Our team is on alert and monitoring the dashboards to make sure we can address any issues/bugs that could arise with a new engine, but rest assured we are equally as excited as you to start releasing some of the content we have been teasing to you. [i]Two additional notes:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Process load times may take a bit longer when you launch. This is expected with the new engine update.,[/p][/*][*][p]Please report any new issues or bugs you might be experiencing in our Discord or contact us at support@starform.co with a screenshot/video, device info, and description.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Content Updates[/b][/h2][p][i]Feral Flight Flight Pass:[/i] Tailed, furry, and armed to their sharp teeth–the latest flight pass goes live <July 5, 2025 at 9:00 AM. Remember to snag yourself some Star Points as well as grant extra Silver to squadmates by purchasing from the web shop![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080690/19ba211f2c7ac3f005cc9c38c53575c1628d27de.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Web Shop Cosmetics: [/i]We’re updating the web shop again by adding 4 previously released Pilot Icons as well as their 4 \[matching] Banners at [url="https://playmetalstorm.com/shop"]playmetalstorm.com/shop[/url]. Pilot Icons will be available for 200 Star Points and Banners for 400. Get them quick before they go away on July 29th. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]General Updates[/b][/h2][p][i]Android Minimum Version:[/i] Alongside this update, Metalstorm will now require users to be on at least Android 10.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Korean Localization Update:[/i] We have done a large pass overhauling and updating the Korean language localization. 즐기다![/p][p][/p][p][i]Minimap Update:[/i] You will now have cardinal directions (North, South, East & West) available to reference on your minimap in game. Never eat soggy waffles! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][p] We are aware of a few bugs and working on a fix for them: [/p][list][*][p]Shadows missing on crates on mobile.,[/p][/*][*][p]Pixel 6 Only: Mig-21 Default + MiG-23 Swoosh paints are showing as black.,[/p][/*][*][p]Pixel 6 Only: The sun is showing through terrain on all maps.,[/p][/*][*][p]North and South are not showing when the big map view is opened.,[/p][/*][*][p]On Crucible, the MVP screen may show bright lava reflections.,[/p][/*][*][p]Shadows rendered on some graphic settings on aircrafts may seem less detailed.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Tailed and Furry-ous![/i][/p]

notes.title: Metalstorm 20250423 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Latest update going live Wednesday, April 23, 2025 8:00 AM PT. There will be a client download for this update, so be on the lookout for your related store download afterwards.

[b][h3]New Hangar Buttons[/h3][/b]
[i]Player Quests:[/i] Pilots new and old will now be able to progress and claim a variety of rewards through the new Quests button in the hangar. Earn new rewards when this goes live! 

[i]2025 Metalstorm Spring Invitational:[/i] Another new button you will see in the hangar–the inaugural Spring Invitational is right around the corner! Spanning across two weekends of Qualifier + Playoff events, be sure to check out the sweatiest Metalstorm competition as they compete for gold, prizes from Backbone, and cold hard cash. For our viewers, we’ll have giveaways and maybe even a special reveal or two we won’t be sharing anywhere else 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080690/41ba742448190fef3b7decbe6dde79dbf5eebb1d.png[/img]

[b][h3]New Naming Systems[/h3][/b]
[i]Squadron Tags:[/i] Your Squadron Tags will now be directly connected to your Pilot Name. You will now no longer have to type these into your pilot names if you want to represent your squadron. By default, yours and other players will be visible. If you do not wish to see these tags however, you can go to your personal Settings and disable the toggle towards the bottom.

[i]Name Changes:[/i] As mentioned in the new post from last week, we are making some changes to name changes. When this update goes live, all players will receive one free name change token. Subsequent pilot name changes will cost 169 gold, and squadron changes will cost 359 gold.

[b][h3]General Updates[/h3][/b]
[i]Death Marks:[/i] Whenever someone is eliminated in battle, you will now see a big X marked over their plane on the scoreboard. This is to help better communicate when someone is out of combat.

[i]Spectator Hotkeys:[/i] In the Spectator Bindings section, you can now enable hotkeys for Players 1-10. Now, whenever you are spectating a match, you can quickly swap between specific players without having to go down the list one by one.

[i]iOS Minimum Requirements:[/i] The iOS min version will be increasing with this update from iOS 14 to iOS 16. Please make sure your device meets this requirement in order to continue flying unaffected.

[b][h3]Plane Adjustments[/h3][/b]
[b]A-6 Intruder[/b]
-    Hangar Level changed from 3 to 4.

[b]Mirage M.III[/b]
- Hangar Level changed from 4 to 3.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Art:
- Fixed an art issue with the shorelines on Stone Forest.
- Fixed some map exploits in Crimson Canyon.
- Fixed an issue with the lighting in the hangar.
- Fixed an issue with floating paint lines while opening crates.
Crashes:
- Fixed an error some players were hitting upon match entry.
UX/UI:
- Fixed a spectator color issue when switching views of each team.
- Fixed an issue with the account menu showing again after initial confirmation.

Poggy woggies!

notes.title: Metalstorm 20250325 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Latest update going live Tuesday, March 25, 2025 8:00 AM. No client download required for this update. 

[h2][b]General Updates[/b][/h2]

[b]New Hangar Scene[/b]
When this update goes live, the first thing you’ll likely see is our brand new hangar! This new scene is filled with a ton of new props, and we can’t wait to see what our community photographers are able to capture. Who knows what secrets may be revealed or discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080690/ba91e8310183566414632927d339ed575f036a18.png[/img]

[b]March Madness[/b]
Starting Friday, March 28, 2025 12:00 PM, we’re bringing back the limited 500 gold offers available exclusively at playmetalstorm.com/shop. There will be one daily offer available for 4 days, and each comes with 200 Star Points you can redeem for additional items as well. Enjoy!

[b]Message Pruning[/b]
You will no longer be able to have more than 50 direct chats in your inbox. This is a preventative measure as there were issues caused from having too much in your inbox. Your history will still be there as you have people rotating in and out of what’s viewable so no worries on anything being lost.

[h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2]

Dev Notes: We’ve made some balance tweaks in this patch, based on both your feedback and our own internal data. Our goal is to make sure every aircraft in Metalstorm feels fun and fair to fly.

Instead of big, sudden changes, we’re taking smaller steps - slowly bringing overpowered planes down and boosting the ones that need a little love. This lets us see how each change plays out, without accidentally tipping the whole balance in the wrong direction.

One trend we’re still seeing: Attack aircraft are a bit too strong overall, especially the Su-25, and it turns out the A-10 as well. We're starting to dial them back a bit, but since we're making changes gradually, we will likely need to make more adjustments later on.

Thanks for flying with us - and keep that feedback coming!

[b]NERFS[/b]

[b]A-4 Skyhawk[/b]
[i]We’re dialing this one back just a bit due to its overperformance after receiving buffs.[/i]
Base Stats
  - HP reduced from 165 to 155.
Rockets
  - Damage reduced from 50 to 45.
  - Blast Radius reduced from 10 to 9m.
  - Rate of Fire reduced from 4.4 to 4/s.

[b]A-10 Thunderbolt[/b]
[i]Despite feeling like a shock to some, the A-10 is one of the best performing planes in Metalstorm. We will be keeping a close eye on how all these changes affect our Attackers.[/i]
Base Stats
  - HP reduced from 220 to 210.
  - Turn Rate reduced from 36 to 35°/s. Note:Roll Rate has also been reduced, but this is not a player facing stat.
Rockets
  - Damage reduced from 50 to 45.
  - Blast Radius reduced from 10 to 9m.
  - Rate of Fire reduced from 4.4 to 4/s.

[b]MiG-19 Farmer[/b]
[i]Same as the A-4. Just a slight nerf to bring it more in line.[/i]
Cannons
  - Max Damage reduced from 236 to 216.

[b]Su-22 Fitter[/b]
[i]Only adjusting the Fitter ever so slightly in this pass of Attackers.[/i]
Rockets
  - Blast Radius reduced from 7 to 6m.

[b]SU-25 Frogfoot[/b]
[i]The Su-25 remains one of the most problematically overpowered planes in the game. As noted, these changes help, and we will keep an eye closely.[/i]
Base Stats
  - HP reduced from 210 to 200.
  - Turn Rate reduced from 36 to 35°/s. Note: Roll Rate has also been reduced, but this is not a player facing stat.
Cannons
  - Ideal Range reduced from < 0.7 to < 0.6km.
  - Reticle Range reduced from < 1.2 to < 0.9km.
  - Now has the Expert Cannons trait. Note: This only affects the aim assist, not the damage, fire rate, or overheat time.
Heavy Rockets
  - Blast Radius reduced from 20 to 18. Note: Accuracy has gone down overall.

[b]Su-34 Fullback[/b]
[i]Just like the A-10, the Su-34 has been a sneaky good plane by our metrics so we’re giving it some slight adjustments.[/i]
Base Stats
  - HP reduced from 185 to 180.
Rockets
  - Damage reduced from 40 to 30.
  - Blast Radius reduced from 9 to 8m.
  - Rate of Fire increased from 6.7 to 8/s.

[b]BUFFS[/b]

[b]A-6 Intruder[/b]
[i]Giving these rockets just a slight adjustment, but watching closely.[/i]
Rockets
  - Damage reduced from 30 to 25.
  - Blast Radius reduced from 8 to 7m.
  - Rate of Fire increased 6.7 to 8/s.

[b]F-4 Phantom[/b]
[i]The Phantom still isn’t in line with where we’d like it, so we’re giving it a little more love.[/i]
Base Stats
  - HP increased from 165 to 170.
  - Ideal Turning Speed reduced from 684 to 666 km/h.
Now has the Cruising Altitude trait.
Hunter Missiles
  - Damage increased from 85 to 90.
  - Lock Angle increased from 7 to 8°.

[b]F-100 Suber Sabre[/b]
[i]Similar to the A-6, and also a sneaky reliable plane–giving its rockets some love.[/i]
Rockets
  - Damage reduced from 30 to 25.
  - Blast Radius reduced from 8 to 7m.
  - Rate of Fire increased 6.7 to 8/s.

[b]J-10 Firebird[/b]
[i]We want to avoid spooking ourselves in overturning the J-10, so we are giving its guns a slight increase as well as a buff to its ability.[/i]
Cannons
  - Max Damage increased from 108 to 115.
Special Ability: Phantom Missile
  - Ability Cooldown has been reduced from 24/18/12 to 20/15/10.
  - Ability Angle increased from 30 to 40°.

[b]Jaguar GR3[/b]
[i]The once dominant Jaguar has been pretty dormant since receiving nerf after nerf. Don’t say we didn’t warn you![/i]
Rockets
  - Damage reduced from 30 to 25.
  - Blast Radius reduced from 8 to 7m.
  - Rate of Fire increased from 3.3 to 4.8/s.

[b]MiG-21 Fishbed[/b]
[i]We’re giving the MiG-21 a slight increase to its guns to bump it up with its very competitive Light Fighters category.[/i]
Cannons
  - Max Damage increased from 108 to 115.

[b]MiG-31 Foxhound[/b]
[i]This Interceptor is getting a little spice to its trait and speed. Gotta go fast![/i]
Base Stats
  - Top Speed Increased from 1501 to 1648km/h.
- Cruising Altitude Max Height reduced from 4000 to 3500. Note: Slightly decreased the speed bonus.

[b]Mirage F1[/b]
[i]Despite its popularity, the F-1 is not winning as many matches as you might suspect. We are giving its ability a very minor buff to monitor.[/i]
Special Ability: Escape Artist
  - Ability now makes missiles slightly less likely to hit you while active.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Art:[/b]
- Fixed a bug with the F4 Mastery paint gold trim.
- Fixed a bug with the Su-25 299th Tactical paint.
- Fixed a bug where the left airbrake sometimes did not show on the Jaguar.
- Fixed an issue with the MiG-19 engine being super dark.
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
- Fixed a bug with the F-15 manual missiles.
[b]Localization:[/b]
- Fixed numerous localization bugs for Japanese.

See you in the skies!

notes.title: Metalstorm 20250219 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Balance Updates[/b][/h3]
[b]Missile Improvements:[/b]
Don’t let this deceptively small change fool you, this will impact every single aircraft in Metalstorm. Missile Turn-Rate Build Up Time determined how long it would take a missile to get from their Starting to Ending Turn Rates. With this value back down to 0, this means your missiles will once again turn at their maximum rate immediately after launch.[b][list][*]Missile Build Up Times returned to 0.[/list][/b]Now that we are back to normal, we look forward to bringing you exciting new planes, maps, and modes, and balance updates that will be smaller and more frequent, to help keep combat both fair and dynamic. 

Speaking of, this is also your general PSA to work on your flaring. You have been warned pilots, good luck out there.

[b]Plane Balance:[/b]
[i]J-10 Firebird[/i][code]There was an unintentional error previously that we are correcting. We’re also sprinkling in a slight range increase to add some potential spicy capabilities with the “Look and Shoot” trait.[/code][list][*]Short Range IRs[list][*]Lock Range increased from 2.8 to 3km.[*]Turn Rate increased from 37 to 45°/s.[/list][/list][i]Su-47 Berkut[/i][code]The Su-47 is a dangerous plane on paper. Its faster rate of fire on radar missiles is reason enough for their additional tracking delay. We are now removing this and bringing them up to par with similar missiles.[/code][list][*]Medium Range Radar Missiles[list][*]These missiles now have no delay before they start tracking targets.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]General Updates[/b][/h3][b]“Reject and Mute” Invites:[/b] Tired when someone can’t get a clue? When this update goes out, you’ll now be able to reject an invite and put someone on mute for 15 minutes in a single button press. 

[b]High Quality Match Replays:[/b] Channel your inner-Spielberg in Match Replays with a new “Force HQ Animations” button. We’re looking forward to seeing what kinds of content you can come up with, and we’ll continue to put in work in enabling your creativity within Metalstorm.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Art[list][*]Fixed an issue with one of the MiG-19 paints.[*]Fixed an issue with decal application on the Su-47.[/list][/list][list][*]Matchmaking[list][*]Fixed an exploit with matchmaking. [i]Note: You will no longer be able to change mods or plane levels while match searching. They will only apply upon re-queue or after that match has ended.[/i][/list][/list]
Last, but certainly not least..

[h3][b]Aircraft Mastery[/b][/h3]Teased in our roadmap last year, Aircraft Mastery is finally here! This is a massive new feature to help you progress, celebrate, and show off your favorite aircraft in Metalstorm. There’s a good bit to unpack here, so strap in and check out the details below.

[i][b]What is Mastery?[/b][/i]
Mastery lets you earn rewards as you fly and refine your skills with each aircraft. Winning matchmade games earns you Mastery XP for the aircraft you are flying, with bonuses for performance and playing with friends. Each aircraft has 24 Mastery Levels full of rewards to unlock! Progress through a Mastery Pass and unlock exclusive cosmetics and valuable resources!

[i][b]What kinds of rewards are available in the Mastery Pass?[/b][/i]
Each plane in the game has their own individual Mastery Pass featuring both FREE + GOLD TIER rewards. These include:

[b]FREE Mastery Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Unlocked through Mastery Levels[list][*]4,400 Silver[/list][list][*]2,200 Parts[/list][list][*]2 Canopy Tints[/list][list][*]2 Mastery Decals[/list][/list][b]GOLD TIER Mastery Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Unlocked Immediately[list][*]Nose Decal Slot[/list][list][*]Permanent 50% Mastery Bonus for Base Victories XP[/list][/list][list][*]Unlocked through Mastery Levels[list][*]12,500 Silver[/list][list][*]3,000 Parts[/list][list][*]Tintable Mastery Decal[/list][list][*]2 Exclusive Canopy Tints[/list][list][*]Empyrean Mastery Paint[/list][list][*]Erebus Mastery Paint[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080690/eb0930e51c318512e7ecaef3833e6f856aee1800.png[/img]

[i][b]How much does the Gold Tier cost?[/b][/i]
To help you unlock the Gold Tier for your favorite plane, your first Gold Tier Mastery Unlock is 50% off! Every unlock after your first one will be the standard 269 Gold.

[i][b]What happens if I unlock the Gold Tier after I’ve already completed all 24 Mastery Levels?[/b][/i]
You will be able to unlock and claim the Mastery Rewards up to whatever point you’re currently at in the Mastery Pass. Note: These rewards and passes will remain forever.

[i][b]Can I use any of these rewards for other planes?[/b][/i]
Outside of Silver since it is a universal currency, no. These passes and their rewards are catered on an individual level of accomplishment with that plane. Any parts or cosmetics will only be applied to that specific plane you are working on.

[i][b]What happens if I already have maximum parts for a plane I claim more parts for?[/b][/i]
Any parts that go beyond what’s needed to reach Plane Level 20 will be converted into Silver.

[i][b]Is there any limit to how many Mastery Passes I can work on at a time?[/b][/i]
Nope! You will naturally be earning Mastery XP as you rotate and play all the aircraft you own in your hangar. Mastery XP is calculated at the end of match depending on the following:
[list][*]Match Victory[list][*]Gold Tier 50% Bonus[/list][list][*]Party Size[/list][/list][list][*]Placement[list][*]1st[/list][list][*]2nd[/list][list][*]3rd[/list][/list]
Trophy Scores affect the base value(s). The higher the risk, the greater the reward as you climb. [i]Note: You can still earn Mastery XP in losses if you manage to get a Top 3 placement![/i]

[u]Which plane will you choose to master first, pilot?[/u]

[h3][b]Stay Tuned[/b][/h3]
We know there’s a good bit to take in with this update, and we’re excited to get these changes and new features into your hands. I wish I could say that’s all for now, but the truth is we’re just getting started. More inbound this month, so be sure to keep an eye out for more updates later this week.
Love &
